name: Adafruit QT Py RP2040
description: XIAO-sized RP2040 with 8 MB flash, USB-C, NeoPixel and STEMMA QT port: a tiny Pico-class board with castellated pads.
notes: 13 GPIO = 11 on the pads + 2 on the STEMMA QT connector (separate I2C1 bus on GPIO22/23).
XIAO-compatible footprint and pad order; 5V pad is VBUS. 3.3 V regulator gives 600 mA peak.
Reset and BOOT buttons; A0-A3 are ADC inputs.
Listed length 21.8 mm includes the USB-C overhang; PCB outline used for the header coordinates is 20.7 mm.
